mapper.insert: INSERT INTO vehicle (fleet_id, plate_no, vin, vehicle_type, rated_tonnage, purchase_date, monitor_enabled, remark) VALUES (#{fleetId}, #{plateNo}, #{vin}, #{vehicleType}, #{ratedTonnage}, #{purchaseDate}, #{monitorEnabled}, #{remark})
mapper.update: UPDATE vehicle SET fleet_id = #{fleetId}, plate_no = #{plateNo}, vin = #{vin}, vehicle_type = #{vehicleType}, rated_tonnage = #{ratedTonnage}, purchase_date = #{purchaseDate}, remark = #{remark} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE vehicle SET monitor_enabled = #{monitorEnabled} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vehicle WHERE fleet_id = #{fleetId}
